sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that though the mediation proceeding between the petitioner and the opposite party no.2 at JHALSA, Ranchi has failed, yet the petitioner is ready to take the opposite party no.2 to his residence.
He further submits that the petitioner shall keep the opposite party no.2 as his wife with full dignity and honour.
2. Considering the said submission, let the petitioner and the opposite party no.2 remain physically present before this Court on the next date fixed.

3. Put up this case under the heading "For Orders"
th on 5 December, 2024.
4.
Till then, interim order dated 23rd September, 2024 shall continue."
3. Pursuant to the aforesaid order, the petitioner and the opposite party no.2 are physically present before this Court.
The petitioner submits that he is ready to take the opposite party no.2 to his house today itself.
He further assures this Court that he will be keeping the opposite party o.2 as his wife with full dignity and honour.
4. Having heard learned counsel for the parties and keeping the aforesaid submission of the petitioner, above named, this Court is inclined to enlarge him on anticipatory bail.

Accordingly, the petitioner, in event of his arrest or surrender before the court below within three weeks from today,
shall be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.20,000/- (Rupees Twenty Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount, each, to the satisfaction of learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Giridih, in connection with Complaint Case no.1144 of 2023, subject to the condition as laid down under Section 482(2) of the B.N.S.S., 2023.

(Rajesh Shankar, J.) Sanjay/
